claims: Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) refers to AI systems that match or exceed human intelligence across a broad range of tasks.
Current artificial narrow intelligence (ANI) specializes in one task.
AGI is characterized by cognitive abilities similar to humans.
AGI can generalize knowledge across domains.
Current AI (like LLMs) is narrowly focused.
AGI implies human-level proficiency in any intellectual task.
Some researchers believe advancements are close to achieving AGI.
True AGI remains a theoretical, future technology.
